correctness.rationale: Normalize M=(1-lambda)R/rho². In the orthogonal [V,W] basis, the full calibrated update G has blocks (I_q, C-BᵀA^{-1}B) and no off-diagonal term. Hence G and its average with M are SPD, including q=d (empty Schur block). Subtracting tr-logdet divergences with the block determinant factorization gives exactly tr A-logdet A-q+tr(BᵀA^{-1}B), zero iff MV=V. Convexity for the average and spectral compactness of the divergence sublevel set make the decrements summable, force A-I and B to vanish uniformly in the varying ranks, and give both (M-I)V→0 and vanishing matrix increments. The fixed-length frame bound now controls the full error: replace each M in a window by its first iterate at o(1) cost and sum the squared errors on the subspaces; the sum is at least beta times the squared Frobenius error. This proves the stated limits including inverse convergence. The derivative at I is lambda E+(1-lambda)W E W for W=I-VVᵀ. For the two lines in Sym(2), the Frobenius overlap of the rank-one unit projectors is cos²(theta). Their relaxed product is lambda² on the perpendicular line and has trace T and determinant lambda² on their span, giving the two roots and a simple stable dominant root r_+. For a sufficiently small initial error epsilon in its dominant direction, use an eigenbasis norm for the epoch map to bound the iterates by O(epsilon q^m) with r_+<q<sqrt(r_+). The dominant left projection after division by r_+^m has sum of nonlinear corrections O(epsilon²) since q²/r_+<1. It therefore has nonzero asymptotic coefficient; the other components divided by r_+^m tend to zero, proving attainment in the nonlinear SPD recursion. Differentiating the larger root in T at T=1+lambda² gives 1/(1-lambda²), yielding the stated small-angle coefficient. The ordinary forgetting two-cycle has phases with swapped weights 1 and lambda; each has condition number governed by trace 1+lambda and determinant lambda sin²(theta), giving the stated comparison.
residual_risks: The archived 2565 numerical assertions are finite corroboration, not proof of uniform deterministic excitation or nonlinear rate attainment. Equal retained singular values and the uniform frame bound are hypotheses of the global guarantee; the rate formula is a local two-direction statement per epoch, not a parameter-error rate.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The linear spectrum and its angular expansion follow by specialization and are not separate contributions. A spectrum for a linear projection algorithm does not identify the nonlinear SIFt Jacobian or prove attainment by a positive-definite orbit; the nonlinear step must be controlled. Similarly the global limit uses the exact Stein decrement and the deterministic window argument, not just equality of the full undamped map to a sketch update.

evidence: Specializing Lai–Bernstein gives precisely (1). With A=I and sketch V the inverse of the Gower–Richtárik full update gives G_V. The logarithmic determinant Bregman projection onto XV=V also gives G_V (the complementary block solves the inverse-block first-order equation). Fält–Giselsson gives the spectrum of a product of individually relaxed projections, including the common-orthogonal block.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The averaged SIFt information iteration is not simply an undamped inverse-block update or standard curvature-pair damping. The linearized epoch derivative is exactly the Fält–Giselsson product with both relaxation parameters 1-lambda and principal cosine cos²(theta); their spectrum specializes exactly to the frozen roots, including lambda².

value.rationale: The limit determines the selected information matrix from arbitrary SPD starts for nonperiodic varying-rank frames, strengthening the interpretation of uniform bounds in this special equal-strength regime. A sharp nonlinear local rate explains why eventual isotropy can coexist with arbitrarily slow equilibration at near-parallel excitation, while ordinary forgetting retains anisotropy. The practical mathematical distinction survives even after crediting the prior projection spectrum.
residual_risks: Not a guarantee for unequal-strength batches, estimator tracking error, or finite-time conditioning at every initial state; the explicit timing comparison is local and two-dimensional.
